systems.platform: open source, Python and Flutter, on GovStack components; integrates with the Integrated Population Registration System (IPRS)
systems.owner: built by Nanocomputing Limited with GIZ and Rift Valley county governments
systems.tiers: pilot in five counties (Bomet, Kericho, Nandi, Uasin Gishu, Elgeyo Marakwet), more than 1,000 farmers, buyers and aggregators registered; county administrations approve suppliers and manage extension officers in it

note: A piloted agricultural marketplace in which county administrations approve suppliers; the document says nothing of where county staff work in it or how county offices are connected.
